description: Deterministic values parity mode injects into the adapters that read the wall clock or a random source. They are installed process-wide at startup when parity.enabled is true (Go: parity/fakes.Install from parity/wiring.Bootstrap) and set per case from envelope.fakes (omitted or zero fields take these defaults). Outside parity mode every seam behaves exactly like the original code. The clock is a fixed instant whose location is UTC; code that explicitly converts to local time (huaweiads getClientTime .Local()) depends on the process time zone, so the runner starts both servers with TZ=UTC. The Rust server must inject the same values at the same sites.

provenance.now_unix_ms: adapters/huaweiads/huaweiadstest fixtures nonce=1629473330823; ISO week 33 like the yieldlab test week generator

adapters.use: time zone offset of the clock (tzo= query parameter); UTC clock gives tzo=0
ts= endpoint query parameter in Unix seconds
user key when no user id is available
clientTime (format 2006-01-02 15:04:05.000 plus the local zone) and the digest-auth nonce in Unix milliseconds
ts= endpoint query parameter in Unix milliseconds
ts= cache buster in Unix seconds and the ISO week number in the targeting/creative ids
